verdict_reason: The filter-dedupe-sort logic is correct and covered by the controller tests, but the key format is parsed here apart from where line-key.js builds it.

todos.issue: The line key format (commodity code, '|', species Latin name) has two homes: line-key.js:4 builds it and keys.js:1-4 codeAndLatinNameOf parses it with its own '|' literal, so a change to the format in one file silently breaks the other (sorting in byCodeThenName and the selected summary in view-model/selected-summary.js).
todos.fix: Must: one module owns the line key format, both building a key and reading its code and Latin name back, and the '|' separator is written once. One way: move codeAndLatinNameOf into line-key.js beside lineKey, sharing a module-level separator constant, and import it from there in keys.js and selected-summary.js.
